title: Seni taklit eden

characters.BIGBOY: a boy of about twelve with short black hair, wearing a red hoodie and blue jeans
characters.LITTLE: a little boy of about six with messy light brown hair, wearing a yellow striped t-shirt
characters.MANBIG: a man of about thirty-five with short black hair, wearing a red wool sweater
characters.MANLITTLE: a man of about thirty with messy light brown hair and a short beard, wearing a mustard yellow jacket

scenes.text:
Küçük kardeşin seni neden hep taklit ederdi,
hiç düşündün mü?
scenes.prompt: In a sunny hallway at home, {BIGBOY} walks ahead on the left, and behind him on the right {LITTLE} proudly copies his walk in oversized sneakers far too big for his feet. Golden autumn light through the window.

scenes.text:
Kıyafetlerini giyer,
senin gibi yürümeye çalışırdı.
scenes.prompt: {LITTLE} stands proudly in a cozy bedroom wearing a red hoodie far too big for him, the sleeves hanging long, chin up like a big boy. Warm afternoon light, autumn leaves falling outside the window.
At a bedroom doorway, {BIGBOY} on the left looks annoyed and is closing the door, while {LITTLE} on the right stands in the hallway looking up at him sadly. Soft evening lamp light.

scenes.text:
Şimdi koca adam oldu;
her büyük kararından önce yine seni arar.
scenes.prompt: At sunset, {MANLITTLE} stands at a big window of a city apartment looking out thoughtfully, a phone lying on the desk beside him, autumn trees glowing outside.

scenes.text:
Çünkü o hâlâ peşinden geliyor.
Bunu kardeşine gönder.
scenes.prompt: On an autumn park path at sunset, {MANBIG} walks ahead on the left and {MANLITTLE} walks one step behind him on the right, both smiling, golden leaves falling around them, seen from the side.

caption:
Kardeşin seni izliyor.

Sen fark etmesen de hep senin izinden yürüdü. 🤍

Bunu kardeşine gönder.
